The *Paṭhamaesanā Sutta* ("Searches [1st]", Iti 54; PTS It 48) is a discourse in the *Itivuttaka* collection [SuttaCentral]. The text expounds upon three types of searches (*esanā*): the search for sensuality, the search for rebirth, and the search for a holy life [SuttaCentral]. The sutta has been translated into multiple modern languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].

Curated passage-level parallels identified on SuttaCentral include the *Samādhi Sutta* of the *Vedanā Saṁyutta* (SN 36.1) as well as two other *Itivuttaka* discourses: the *Paṭhamavedanā Sutta* (Iti 52) and the *Paṭhamaāsava Sutta* (Iti 56) [SuttaCentral]. Automated text-reuse analysis from DharmaNexus confirms extensive shared material with Iti 52 (segments 0.1–5.1), Iti 56 (segments 2.4–5.1), and SN 36 [DharmaNexus; SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus also reveals substantial Pali-internal text reuse with the *Magga Saṁyutta* (SN 45, notably segments 2.1–2.4 matching SN 45.161), the subsequent *Dutiyaesanā Sutta* (Iti 55), and several other *Itivuttaka* suttas including Iti 95, Iti 90, Iti 53, Iti 57, and Iti 59 [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meet the threshold score in the DharmaNexus corpus [DharmaNexus].
